what_to_test:
Juggle Dude 1.2.0 (37) — replay editor upgrade

• Record or import a juggling clip, open the replay editor, and try Looks: Power-up, Every, Custom and New look here. Check ball/effect changes, seeking, looping and replay playback.
• Try touch sounds, look-change sounds, milestone fanfares and muting the original clip audio. Save a video to Photos and check that the sound and visuals match the editor.
• Try timer styles and milestone celebrations. Move and resize overlays, save My style, then reopen a replay and check the saved choices.
• Change the app language to English, German, Spanish, French or Brazilian Portuguese and check the editor labels. “TOUCHES” in videos and “Milestones” remain English by design.
• On iPhone 11 and other older phones, check editor responsiveness, ball appearance, longer replay playback and export. On iOS 18, keep the app open during preparation/export.
• Check free and Pro access, restore purchases, recording/history, and automatic leaderboard updates. This build keeps the existing counting rules; the separate touch-counting research is not included.

Source: feature/leaderboard-editor-upgrade, commit 8c330016.
